full_query: How am I supposed to put ointment on my nipple if it's pierced
sentences: If you have a pierced nipple, applying ointment can be a bit more challenging
However, it is essential to continue taking care of your nipple to prevent infection and promote healing
Gently clean the piercing area with saline solution before applying ointment
Dry the area thoroughly before applying the ointment
Use a clean and sterile applicator or cotton swab to apply a small amount of ointment directly to the piercing
Gently rotate the piercing to prevent the ointment from accumulating in one area, which can cause irritation
Avoid tight clothing that may irritate the piercing or ointment
Follow the instructions of your piercer or healthcare provider regarding ointment use and frequency of application
It is also crucial to note that if you experience any signs of infection, such as redness, swelling, or discharge, you should consult your piercer or healthcare provider immediately
